verdict.rationale: Together's official TypeScript SDK states that it supports streaming responses using Server Sent Events (SSE), which covers the core of this story. The OpenAI-compatible API is consistent with standard streaming workflows but does not mention streaming explicitly. Missing for 10: first-party API/docs page detailing token-by-token stream chunk format and the `stream` parameter on chat completions, independent or hands-on corroboration of streaming latency/responsiveness.
